# Veryfront Code documentation

These docs ship with veryfront 0.1.1285. Read the relevant guide before changing framework code in a consuming project. Start with [Local quickstart](./getting-started/quickstart.md), then use the task guides or generated API reference below.

Edit source comments and regenerate API reference; do not edit generated reference directly. Website docs may describe a newer version.
